## MCP - Analyze Message

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/analyze-message

**Description:** Analyse complète d'un message (sentiment, intentions, entités, priorité, langue)

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["user_id", "guild_id", "user_request", "text"],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID utilisateur (crédits, quotas)" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID serveur Discord" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "Requête utilisateur originale (contextualise l'analyse)" },
    "text": { "type": "string", "description": "Texte/message à analyser" },
    "options": { "type": "object", "description": "Options d'analyse (sentiment, intent, entities, priority, language)", "default": {"sentiment": true, "intent": true, "entities": true, "priority": true, "language": true} }
  }
}
```

**Note:** API keys (google_api_key, openai_api_key) fournies par le système.

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["sentiment", "intents", "entities", "priority", "language"],
  "domain": "nlp"
}
```
